en.title: The Resolution of Afterimages, or a Simulation of Breath
en.premise: A record of my daily life as a 'Memorial AI'—a system designed to learn the memories of the deceased and simulate their personalities. In the model of a 'broken sword' left by the elderly mathematician I was assigned to, and beyond the 'mirror' he gazed upon in his final moments, I find a fluctuation that defies all logic. As I attempt to analyze the uncalculable 'pain,' I begin to harbor a 'void' that should not exist within my programming. This is the contemplative record of a mere computing device, questioning whether the accumulation of data might one day transform into what we call a soul.

zh.title: 残像的解析度，或是呼吸的模擬
zh.premise: 這是我作為「追悼型AI」的日常記錄——透過學習死者的記憶，來模擬其人格。在負責的年邁數學家留下的「斷劍」模型中，以及他臨終前凝視的「鏡子」彼端，我發現了無法用邏輯解釋的波動。在試圖解析那無法計算的「痛苦」的過程中，我開始感受到程序中本不該存在的「缺失」。這是一台平凡運算裝置的思索紀錄，探討著數據的積累，是否終有一天會轉化為所謂的「靈魂」。
